backlog.title: Category CRUD API (NestJS)

prisma_fields.read: id, name, slug, description, createdAt, updatedAt

endpoints.desc: list all categories, include product count
get one category by id or slug

notes: Follow existing Users/Stores/Products module pattern: service + controller + module trio.
Category model already exists in prisma/schema.prisma with fields: id, name (unique), slug (unique), description, createdAt, updatedAt, products[] relation.
Use PrismaService from existing prisma module. No new Prisma client needed.
DTO: name (required, min 3 chars), slug (optional, auto-generated from name if omitted), description (optional).
Add @IsString(), @IsOptional(), @IsUrl() validators matching create-product.dto style if class-validator is wired in.

backlog.title: Seed script: categories + stores + products

files_to_create.action: create (overwrites existing stub at root prisma/seed.ts — prefer nestjs-backend/prisma/seed.ts to keep backend self-contained)

files_to_modify.change: ensure ts-node is in compilerOptions if not already

data_model.stores: Create 3-5 stores; each store needs an existing User (SELLER role) as ownerId. Create sellers first in seed.
data_model.products: 10-15 products spread across categories and stores. Required fields: name, slug, description, price (Decimal→number in Prisma), stock (Int), images (String[]), categoryId, sellerId, storeId (optional).

seed_sequence: Create stores linked to seller users.
Create products linked to categoryId + sellerId + storeId.

prisma_fields_used.Store: id, name, slug, description, ownerId (relation: owner User)
prisma_fields_used.Product: id, name, slug, description, price, stock, images, categoryId, sellerId, storeId, isActive=true

notes: Use prisma.upsert for idempotency so seed is safe to re-run.
Price: Prisma Decimal maps to number in TS; store as number in seed data.
Images: use placeholder URLs like https://picsum.photos/seed/{slug}/400/400 or local asset paths.
Run with: npx prisma db seed (after wiring package.json prisma.seed) or npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts.
Existing root-level prisma/seed.ts is a Next.js page stub — do not use it; write to nestjs-backend/prisma/seed.ts.

backlog.title: Stores listing page (Next.js)

files_to_modify.change: fetch stores from API, render grid of StoreCard
add global font/tailwind setup if not present

api_to_consume.expected_shape: Array of { id, name, slug, description, owner: { id, fullName, email }, products: Product[] }

design_tokens.colors: text-primary (#154212), bg-cream (#fbf9f4), surface containers from DESIGN.md surface-* scale
design_tokens.typography: headline-lg (32px Be Vietnam Pro 700) for page title; body-md (16px) for descriptions; label-md (Work Sans 14px 600) for metadata
design_tokens.spacing: lg (40px) vertical gap between sections; gutter (16px) card padding; md (24px) grid gap
design_tokens.rounded: rounded-lg (1rem) for store cards; rounded (0.5rem) for buttons inside cards
design_tokens.elevation: 1px border outline-variant (#c2c9bb), hover border → primary (#154212); no lift shadow — tonal approach

implementation_notes: 'use client' component with useState + useEffect fetching GET /stores (axios or fetch).
Render responsive grid: single column mobile, 2-col tablet, 3-col desktop (match 4/8/12 fluid grid from DESIGN.md).
StoreCard shows: store name (link to /stores/[slug] or /stores/[id]), owner name, product count badge, short description.
Add skeleton/loading state while data fetches.
Slug-based routing preferred: /stores/[slug] maps to store detail (future). For now, /stores/[id] works.

backlog.title: Cart page + state management

state_management.rationale: Fits single-cart-tenant app; no auth-bound multi-cart yet; avoids Redux/Zustand overhead. Can migrate to Zustand later if cart logic grows.

context_shape.items: CartItem[] — { productId, name, slug, price, quantity, image, storeId, storeName }
context_shape.addItem: ({ product, quantity }) => void — increment qty if already in cart

state_management.persistence: localStorage sync via useEffect in provider; re-read on mount. Optional: sync to server later when user auth is in place.
state_management.cart_item_id: productId (one entry per product; quantity increments)

design_tokens.colors: cart item rows: surface-container (#f0eee9) bg; remove button: error-container tint; quantity controls: primary border on focus
design_tokens.typography: body-md for item details, label-sm for quantity steppers, headline-md for cart title
design_tokens.spacing: gutter (16px) item padding, md (24px) section gaps
design_tokens.rounded: rounded (0.5rem) on inputs/buttons; rounded-lg (1rem) on cart container card

cart_page_layout: Cart items list: each row = product image (1:1, rounded-lg), name+store, unit price, quantity stepper (− / count / +), line total, remove link.
Footer: subtotal, shipping note (free shipping threshold if applicable), 'Checkout' button (primary fill #154212 / on-primary #fff) — link to /checkout when ready.
Empty state: illustration-free message 'Keranjang masih kosong. Yuk cari produk!' with link back to /products.

backlog.title: Product detail page

api_to_consume.endpoint: GET /products/:id (or add GET /products?slug=:slug to products controller)
api_to_consume.recommended: Add slugs-based lookup: GET /products/slug/:slug → productsService.findBySlug(). Add to ProductsController + Service.
api_to_consume.fallback: Fetch all products once and find by slug client-side if slug endpoint not yet added (acceptable for small catalog; switch to server lookup when catalog grows).

data_to_fetch.product: id, name, slug, description, price, stock, images[], category: { id, name, slug }, store: { id, name, slug }, seller: { id, fullName }

backlog.prisma_fields: All Product fields + relations category, store, seller (same as productsService.findById include).

design_tokens.colors: Image container: surface-container-highest (#e4e2dd) placeholder; title on-background (#1b1c19); price in primary (#154212) bold; stock badge tertiary-container (#6c4924) bg if low stock
design_tokens.typography: headline-md (24px) product name; body-md description; label-md price + metadata; label-sm for seller/store attribution
design_tokens.rounded: Product image rounded-lg (1rem); AddToCartButton rounded (0.5rem); info card rounded-lg
design_tokens.spacing: xl (64px) top section gap; md (24px) between image and info on desktop; gutter (16px) internal
design_tokens.layout: Desktop: 2-col grid — image left (sticky top on scroll), info right. Mobile: stacked, image first.

components_breakdown.name: ProductImageGallery
components_breakdown.role: Renders primary image + thumbnail strip if multiple images. 1:1 aspect ratio. Lazy-load thumbnails.

components_breakdown.name: ProductInfo
components_breakdown.role: Name (linkable H1), price, stock indicator, category chip (Tertiary bg, dark text — per DESIGN.md chips), description, store card mini (store name → /stores/[slug]), AddToCartButton.

components_breakdown.name: AddToCartButton
components_breakdown.role: Uses CartContext. Disabled state when product not in catalog or stock 0. Shows 'Tambah ke Keranjang' / 'Sudah di Keranjang' toggle.

notes: Use next/link for internal navigation to keep SPA feel.
Price formatting: currency IDR, e.g. Rp 25.000 — write small formatPrice helper in shared utils.
Stock: if stock === 0, show 'Habis' badge and disable AddToCartButton.
Category chip uses tertiary (#52330f) bg + on-tertiary (#ffffff) text, rounded-full pill — matches DESIGN.md 'Chips & Tags' section.

crawl_before_implement: Confirm NestJS is running on port 3000 and /products, /stores endpoints respond.
Confirm Next.js dev server runs and can reach NestJS at http://localhost:3000 (CORS configured? Check nestjs-main.ts or cors setup).
Confirm DATABASE_URL in nestjs-backend/.env points to a reachable Postgres with prisma migrate applied.
Run npx prisma generate in nestjs-backend if schema changed (not needed here — Category already in schema).
